fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local reporting on Miami politics and public utilities, urging municipal takeover of Florida Power & Light and criticizing high electric bills; reports on an annulment case involving Joseph E. Jacobson and alleged court scandal; coverage of Dade County zoning enforcement against an elderly resident’s trailer; a column describing alleged prostitution activity at a bar/restaurant on South Miami Avenue; court and police blotter items; summaries of Florida Attorney General opinions; discussion of labor issues including the Taft-Hartley Act; and commentary on charitable foundations and other civic matters.
